blocks.heading: Questions? We can read your mind

items.q: What undergraduate programs are offered by ATLAS ISME?

c: ATLAS ISME offers several undergraduate programs in BBA (Hons.) and one program in B.Sc. (Hons.), i.e B.Sc. in Finance.

Specialisations such as Finance, Marketing, Digital Branding & Advertising, and AI & Emerging Technologies are full-time, 4-year undergraduate programs designed to build industry-ready, future-focused business leaders:
BBA (Hons.) with Majors & Minors: A customisable program that lets students specialise in one area while exploring others.
Majors:
Marketing
Finance
Minors (choice-based):
Entrepreneurship
Business Analytics
Finance
Operations and Supply Chain Management
Marketing
Economics
Human Resource Management
BBA (Hons.) in Digital Branding & Advertising: Students learn branding strategy, digital media, content marketing etc.
BBA (Hons.) in AI & Emerging Technologies: Students learn about Artificial Intelligence, automation, and emerging business technologies
B.Sc. (Hons.) in Finance: Students learn about Financial analysis, investment strategies, markets, and portfolio management

items.q: Is there an option to major in Finance or Marketing at ATLAS ISME?

c: Yes, for interested students, there is an option to major in Finance and Marketing at ATLAS ISME.
ATLAS ISME- School of management & entrepreneurship offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs specifically in
B.Sc. (Hons.) in Finance
BBA (Hons.) Major in Finance
BBA (Hons.) Major in Marketing
BBA (Hons.) in AI & Emerging Technologies
MBA in Finance
MBA in Marketing
MBA in Fintech (which includes AI-related skills)
Finance: Those students who have a knack for numbers can pursue a B.Sc. (Hons.) in Finance or major or minor in finance within the BBA (Hons.) degree.

Marketing: The current landscape is demanding and requires business skills as well as skills that are well-suited for a modern marketing environment, and a specialised BBA (Hons.) in Digital Branding & Advertising is perfect for it.

items.q: Are internships a mandatory part of the ATLAS ISME curriculum? Is there a Placement Team at ATLAS ISME?

c: Yes, internships are a mandatory part of the ATLAS ISME curriculum, and there is a dedicated Placement Team at ATLAS ISME.

ATLAS ISME programs are divided into varied semesters, where internships constitute a major part of the curriculum. ATLAS ISME School of Management & Entrepreneurship emphasises experiential learning and partners with a broad range of organisations across industries, from boundary-breaking start-ups to business leaders who allow students to learn from and work across disciplines alongside the best in business and embark on a career path that can leave its indelible mark on the global landscape.

Career Support Team: ATLAS ISME has a dedicated Career Services team that provides support for both mandatory internships and placements. This team helps students with resume building, interview coaching, career guidance, training, and industry access to help them achieve their career aspirations.

items.q: What out-of-classroom learning opportunities are available at ATLAS ISME?

c: ATLAS ISME is proud of its teaching methods. The methods extend beyond traditional learning. They include opportunities, such as
Live projects: Students apply theoretical knowledge to real-life scenarios and projects.
Global immersions: Through international exposure and networking opportunities, students can learn about different businesses.
Industry mentorship: The program allows students to connect with industry stalwarts and gain knowledge from their expertise.
Atlas elective: The Atlas elective allows students to be a part of the vibrant campus life and learn from the experience.
Product showcases: Atlas focuses on developing skills such as critical thinking for students to come up with innovative solutions.

items.q: Does ATLAS ISME offer international exchange or global immersion programs?

c: Yes, ATLAS ISME offers international exchange and global immersion programs. Harnessing the power of technology, entrepreneurs transform a blank canvas of ideas into vibrant and thriving businesses that create job opportunities and contribute significantly to the national and global economy. With world-class faculty, experiential ecosystems, industry-driven curriculum, and future-ready management programs, we transform young learners into leaders.

c: Atlas offers a rich array of real-world simulations and decision-making scenarios integrated into the academic curriculum. We are renowned for:

Business simulations: Leveraging advanced business simulation tools, we are able to replicate dynamic market environments, allowing students to experience the immediate consequences of their choices in a risk-free setting.
Live projects: The program mandates participation in live industry projects and corporate immersions.
ATLAS Electives: Atlas electives focus on ensuring students can gain immense learning from structured debates on contemporary business dilemmas, enhancing critical thinking.

items.q: What is the Global Business Pathway program with Northeastern University?

c: The Global Business Pathway is an exclusive program where students start their undergraduate business degree at ATLAS ISME in Mumbai and complete it at Northeastern University’s London campus, followed by an optional 1-year Master’s program in London or Boston. This offers a globally recognized degree, international academic exposure, and access to Northeastern’s powerful global network.
Students who enroll through ATLAS receive a 25% exclusive tuition scholarship that applies to both the undergraduate transfer portion and the optional master’s program at Northeastern.

Please note this is not a dual, joint, or twinning degree. Students apply separately for transfer and master’s admission to Northeastern University, and admissions and visa outcomes are subject to university review and immigration regulations.

ATLAS ISME
